access_windows_length_check.name: access_windows_length_check
access_windows_length_check.value: "access_windows"."ends_at" > "access_windows"."starts_at" and "access_windows"."ends_at" - "access_windows"."starts_at" <= case "access_windows"."kind" when 'setup' then 259200 else 86400 end

invites_contact_check.name: invites_contact_check
invites_contact_check.value: "invites"."email" is not null or "invites"."phone" is not null

outages_device_check.name: outages_device_check
outages_device_check.value: "outages"."box_id" is not null or "outages"."camera_id" is not null

service_hours_time_check.name: service_hours_time_check
service_hours_time_check.value: length("service_hours"."opens_at") = 5 and time("service_hours"."opens_at") is not null and length("service_hours"."closes_at") = 5 and time("service_hours"."closes_at") is not null

users_contact_check.name: users_contact_check
users_contact_check.value: "users"."email" is not null or "users"."phone" is not null
